title: Can occupational therapy help my child tolerate different types of clothing materials?
metaTitle: Developing Tolerance to Clothing Materials Through Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network's occupational therapy helps children develop tolerance and comfortably adapt to different clothing materials.
html: Particularly yes. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, our occupational therapists understand that varying textures, especially in clothing materials, can be challenging for some children. Using desensitization techniques and our uniquely tailored therapeutic strategies, we diligently work to help your child progressively adjust and become more tolerant to different tactile stimuli such as those found in various clothing materials.
